obligations.expected_behavior: Maintain bidirectional Exact Cover links between every Atomic Obligation and the corresponding assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence.
forbidden_result: Any Atomic Obligation lacks required bidirectional Exact Cover coverage.
Coverage exists only in one direction or omits one of the specified node types.
obligations.observable_result: A verifiable traceability relation demonstrates bidirectional Exact Cover for every Atomic Obligation across assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence.
obligations.state_after: All Atomic Obligations have complete bidirectional Exact Cover across the specified node types.
obligations.state_before: The traceability relation has not yet been established as complete and bidirectional for all Atomic Obligations.
obligations.subject: Atomic Obligation traceability coverage
obligations.trigger: When validating or compiling the obligation-to-node traceability graph.

obligations.expected_behavior: Ensure the Exact Cover graph contains no orphan assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, runtime evidence, or Atomic Obligations.
forbidden_result: Any node in the Exact Cover graph is unlinked or orphaned.
An Atomic Obligation or covered node exists outside the bidirectional coverage relation.
obligations.observable_result: Validation reports zero orphan nodes in the complete Exact Cover graph.
obligations.state_after: Every node in the graph participates in the bidirectional Exact Cover relation, with no orphan nodes.
obligations.state_before: The graph may contain unlinked or orphaned nodes pending validation.
obligations.subject: Exact Cover graph orphan prevention
obligations.trigger: When validating the completeness of the Exact Cover graph.
